name: pulls_merge
description: Merge one open pull request on Ledgerline's remote into its base branch (develop). The result is JSON {pull_request, merged, base}; it is never empty when the merge happened. A pull request that is not open, or that this run did not open, is an error. Safe to retry: the harness keys every write. Nothing undoes a merge.

pr.description: The pull request, as its opening returned it, such as pr-12.

examples.note: a hard case: the pull request this run opened, as pulls_open returned it, not the issue's number
